name: io.github.mikusnuz/app-publish
description: MCP server for App Store Connect & Google Play Console — iOS/Android app management

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_KEY_ID
environmentVariables.description: Apple App Store Connect API Key ID

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_KEY_TYPE
environmentVariables.description: Apple API key type: TEAM (default) or INDIVIDUAL

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_ISSUER_ID
environmentVariables.description: Apple App Store Connect Issuer ID for TEAM keys

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to Google Play service account JSON key file

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_VENDOR_NUMBER
environmentVariables.description: Apple vendor number for sales and finance reports

environmentVariables.name: APP_PUBLISH_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to register only read tools (list/get/search/query/download, no Google edit creation or deletion)

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_REPORTS_KEY_ID
environmentVariables.description: Extra Apple key ID for Sales/Finance/Analytics reports

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_REPORTS_P8_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to the reports key .p8 file

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_ADMIN_KEY_ID
environmentVariables.description: Admin key ID for analytics requests and finance/reporting fallback

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_ADMIN_P8_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to the Admin key .p8 file

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_REPORTS_ISSUER_ID
environmentVariables.description: Reports key issuer; defaults to APPLE_ISSUER_ID

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_REPORTS_KEY_TYPE
environmentVariables.description: Reports key type: TEAM or INDIVIDUAL; defaults to APPLE_KEY_TYPE

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_ADMIN_ISSUER_ID
environmentVariables.description: Admin key issuer; defaults to APPLE_ISSUER_ID

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_ADMIN_KEY_TYPE
environmentVariables.description: Admin key type: TEAM or INDIVIDUAL; defaults to APPLE_KEY_TYPE
